text:
lucas_ops: Announcement: opening additional Dedicated capacity in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). We're adding a mixed pool of L40s and a small H100v3 tranche and enabling a new "commit-plus-burst" allocation policy for cost-sensitive customers.

anya_infra: Config landed in infra-config: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/eu-central-1/`

```yaml
# l40s-euc1-extra.yaml
pool_name: l40s-euc1-extra
capacity_gpus: 32
allocation_policy: standard
preemption: conditional

# h100v3-euc1-tranche.yaml
pool_name: h100v3-euc1-tranche
capacity_gpus: 8
availability: invite_only
allocation_policy: reserved-first

# commit-plus-burst-policy.yaml
policy_name: commit-plus-burst
description: "Reservations can commit to baseline GPUs and additionally request burst slots that are best-effort for short windows. Billing uses committed rates + capped burst surcharge."
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.44 deployed by anya_infra 14:02UTC deploy id `deploy-2026-03-27-0903` :white_check_mark:

meera_sales: Customer impact? We need clear notes for account teams on who gets access and billing.

lucas_ops: Access: L40s extra pool is public (standard dedicated). H100v3 tranche is invite-only for customers who sign the pilot addendum. Commit-plus-burst will be opt-in; customers choose when they create reservations.

olaf_sre: Monitoring added: `commit_burst_usage`, `burst_preempt_events`, `queue_age_by_policy`. Temporary alert: if `burst_preempt_events>10` in 1h -> convert burst windows to drain-only and page SRE.

zara_prod: Policy rationale: this gives small-to-medium customers better tail latency while preserving enterprise reserved commitments. Also helps smooth demand spikes without permanent capex.

meera_sales: Pricing model for commit-plus-burst? Finance proposes committed rate + 1.5x burst cap, with monthly cap to protect customers. Will finalize after pilot.

anya_infra: Ops note: H100v3 nodes are in a single rack for now (thermal/placement reasons). We enabled extra NVLink checks and set `nvlink_err_rate` thresholds tighter for the tranche.

lucas_ops: Rollout plan: L40s extra pool active now. H100v3 tranche open to invites only. Commit-plus-burst feature enabled as opt-in in console for eu-central-1. Observing for 72h before considering expansion to other regions.

olaf_sre: Oncall rota for monitoring window: olaf_sre, anya_infra, and jules_sre. Dashboards: `dedicated.eu-central-1.*`, `dedicated.policies.commit-plus-burst.*`.

status-bot: Status updated: "Added L40s extra capacity and H100v3 invite tranche in eu-central-1. Commit-plus-burst policy enabled (opt-in). Monitoring active."

meera_sales: I'll draft customer-facing copy and send invites to pilot customers. Draft snippet: "We added extra Dedicated capacity in Frankfurt and are piloting an opt-in commit-plus-burst reservation option to improve fulfillment during spikes. Contact your account team to opt in."

lucas_ops: Rollback: revert pool entries in infra-config and disable commit-plus-burst flag. Drain rules preserve active reservations during rollback. If we see elevated preemptions or thermal alarms, we'll pause the burst windows immediately.

zara_prod: Thanks team. Please channel any customer feedback or odd metrics back into this thread. We'll collect data for the pilot review after 72h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
